# Assistant UI binding snapshot

Copied from the MIT-licensed snapshot in [Wybe v1 v0.1.1](https://github.com/theoriclabs/wybe_v1/tree/v0.1.1/Wybe/UserFacingInterfaces/Web/vendor/assistant-ui). That snapshot came from the pre-extraction LeanReact binding. Includes the image and structured tool argument bindings used by Loom Viewer. The browser entry imports the LeanReact runtime pinned by the viewer.
